production.alternativeScope: candidate alternative to 4x4 sixteen-region scheme; sources/art/history retained; no batch production authorization
production.coreOwnership: min-inclusive/max-exclusive; red outer maximum inclusive; boundary source IDs intentionally shared as references
production.buildingSeamRule: Use shared complete footprint and a single owner for whole building silhouette; ground core mask is not permission to cut a building. Resolve overhang before integrating.
production.sourceIdConvention: roads/nodes use original IDs; buildings/areas/waterways use zero-based indices in pinned city.json; bbox polygon lists are conservative candidates, not exact occupied-area intersections
production.roadsOutsideBlue: source reference/landscape context only; no delivery extension
production.generationCadence: one whole region then user review; no batch generation; no small-image composite
